# Smoke-check fixtures

These files are unmodified snapshots from `microsoft/vscode`, distributed under
the MIT license (copyright Microsoft Corporation):

- `extensions/php/syntaxes/php.tmLanguage.json`
- `extensions/php/syntaxes/html.tmLanguage.json` (stored as `php-html.tmLanguage.json`)
- `extensions/javascript/syntaxes/JavaScript.tmLanguage.json`
- `extensions/theme-defaults/themes/dark_plus.json`
- `extensions/theme-defaults/themes/dark_vs.json`

Retrieved 2026-10-26. They are used only by the focused checks and are excluded
from the VSIX. The JavaScript and PHP grammar files retain their upstream
attribution and source information.
